tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus and the sheet a dialog sits on; in the High contrast theme it is told from `surface` by a `border`, not by shade.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Input and control outlines and the rules that divide regions — at least 3:1 against `surface` and `surface-raised` in every theme (4.5:1 in the High contrast theme).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only, never the sole edge of a control; the High contrast theme aliases it to `border`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on `surface` and `surface-raised`; 13px and up.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, the selected state, and link text on `surface` and `surface-raised` (links are always underlined). Seazar is ink-on-paper: the accent IS the ink, so it flips with the theme.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring color (the `focus-ring` shadow draws it outside a 2px gap in the page color); an alias of `accent`, at least 3:1 against `surface` and `surface-raised` in every theme (4.5:1 in the High contrast theme).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, running to time, available — the chip fill. Okabe–Ito blue in Light and Dark; the label it carries is `on-success`. A standalone mark (icon, dot) uses `success-ink`, not this.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Chip label and icon on a `success` fill.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Success as text or a small mark (check icon, dot) on `surface` and `surface-raised`; the word or icon always comes with it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Delayed, needs attention — the chip fill. Okabe–Ito yellow in every theme; its label is always dark (`on-warning`). Warning TEXT is not this yellow: see `warning-ink`.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Chip label and icon on a `warning` fill.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning as text or a small mark (triangle icon) on `surface` and `surface-raised` — Okabe–Ito orange, darkened in Light and High contrast (the yellow fill cannot make legible text). Red–green color-blind readers cannot tell it from `danger-ink` by color alone, so the icon or word is what differs.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Canceled, failed, destructive — the chip fill. Okabe–Ito vermillion in Light and Dark; a standalone mark uses `danger-ink`.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Chip label and icon on a `danger` fill.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions as text or a small mark (cross icon) on `surface` and `surface-raised`; an error message starts with the icon. Okabe–Ito vermillion moved only in lightness — darkened well past the floor in Light and High contrast, so there danger text is heavier than warning text as well as different in hue; lifted just to the floor in Dark.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Notices that are not alarms — the chip fill. A plain mid gray by design: information carries no signal hue.

tokens.name: on-info
tokens.usage: Chip label and icon on an `info` fill.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Informational text or the info icon on `surface` and `surface-raised`; an alias of `ink-muted`.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: One family; body never below 16px, nothing below 13px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The 14:05 to the harbor is running to time.
styles.usage: Everything else; line length under 75 characters.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Labels and metadata; the smallest size in the system.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status chips.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Nothing clickable is smaller than this in either direction (WCAG 2.2 Target Size minimum); icon buttons pad up to it.

shadow.note: Two elevations; the High contrast theme drops them for borders.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards and inputs at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers — which also keep their `border`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in the page color, then 2px of `focus` (box-shadow, so it follows the radius). The two hexes per theme are that theme's `surface` and `focus` values; change them together.
